shared_elements: human figure (relief figures in A, sculpted body in B)
repeated symbolic signs in a raised field
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both surfaces carry a carved disc/ring motif and shallow curvilinear bands associated with a human form, which any carving tradition might independently produce. A shows a dense narrative scene of profile figures with raised arms beneath a rayed disc above an offering table, framed by registers of small repeated signs, whereas B shows a single frontal three-dimensional body with a few isolated, sparse schematic motifs (ring, arcs, a headdress-like band) and no scene, no interaction between figures, and no narrative register system.
